findings.problem: The plan changes the helper’s output contract from escaping every apostrophe in every reply to percent-encoding four characters only inside locators, but it does not update its named source spec. The Reading module section of docs/specs/knowledge-base.md currently requires the old whole-reply apostrophe escape. This leaves the project’s source of truth contradicting the intended implementation.
findings.suggestion: Add docs/specs/knowledge-base.md to scope and an increment that replaces the obsolete behavior statement with the locator-only percent-encoding and read-side decoding contract.

summary: The plan otherwise addresses the prior locator-only guarantee, but it must reconcile the named spec before it can be relied on.
